premises.text: Existing voice assistants fail because they do not work with the most popular apps people actually use
premises.evidence_span: they don't work with the most popular apps out there

premises.text: Existing voice assistants also limit their technology to only a few apps
premises.evidence_span: they limit their technology to only a few apps

premises.text: VoiceSphere lets users talk to many popular consumer apps from a personal app feed without leaving the product
premises.evidence_span: VoiceSphere works with 20 of the most popular apps right from the start

premises.text: An API hub IDE lets integrations for new apps be created quickly with a few lines of code
premises.evidence_span: the API hub is really advanced technology that allows us to integrate more and more apps really fast

premises.text: Professionals can reach complex business software data and actions by voice through VoiceSphere
premises.evidence_span: professionals could reach all the data and functionality of these products just with their voice

premises.text: An open enterprise store lets business products with APIs sell VoiceSphere access while VoiceSphere takes a share of each sale
premises.evidence_span: They can integrate their application and sell the VoiceSphere access to their customers inside our enterprise store

domains.name: Consumer app voice layer and API hub

value.text: Talk to everything on your phone — favorite apps and complex software — by voice

secondary_value.text: Make professionals' work easier and more efficient via purchased enterprise integrations
secondary_value.evidence_span: Professionals can buy the integrations to make their work more easy and efficient
